Question 13

Consider the following initial value problem. xdydx+2y=4x2,y(1)=2 Select the correct options below. An integrating factor for this equation is I(x)=
 
x2
ex
e2x
2x
.

The solution to the initial value problem is y(x)=
 
3x2−1x2
x2+1x2
x+1x2
3x−1x2
.
